 Transactional accounting or project administration experience (accounts payable, accounts receivable or cost coding)

 Woodfibre LNG is seeking an experienced Analyzer Technician to join our dynamic team. Reporting to the Electrical & Instrumentation Supervisor , the successful candidate will support preventive, predictive, corrective, turnaround, and emergency maintenance activities. Key responsibilities include installing, calibrating, maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing process analyzers, analyzer sample conditioning systems, and associated instrumentation to ensure accurate and reliable process measurements. This role offers an opportunity to be part of a dedicated team, ensuring the safe, reliable, efficient, and environmentally responsible operation of the Woodfibre LNG facility.

 The successful applicant will:
 Support start-up and operations of the LNG plant 
 Troubleshoot and repair process analyzers such as Gas Chromatographs, Continuous Emissions Monitoring Systems (CEMS), Reid Vapor Pressure (RVP) analyzers, moisture analyzers, oxygen analyzers, and associated analyzer sample conditioning systems.

 Utilize remote connectivity and digital support platforms, as required, to perform diagnostics, configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and maintenance of analyzer systems in collaboration with Operations, Engineering, OEMs, and third-party service providers
 Support Process Safety Management - Maintain analyzer systems that support process safety, environmental compliance, and operational integrity. SIS awareness, Alarm philosophy, Functional Safety
 Inspect, test, calibrate, and validate analyzer systems to ensure accurate and reliable process measurements using electrical, electronic, pneumatic, and analytical testing equipment.
 Perform scheduled preventive, predictive, and emergency maintenance on analyzer systems, completing all maintenance reports, calibration records, and equipment history documentation.
 Perform mechanical work associated with analyzer repair and modification, including the removal and installation of tubing, sample lines, regulators, filters, sample conditioning equipment, and analyzer components.
 Perform analyzer calibration using certified calibration gases and reference standards while maintaining measurement accuracy and compliance with manufacturer recommendations.
 Troubleshoot analyzer communication interfaces with the ICSS, PLCs, and associated control systems.
 Provide day-to-day support to ensure maximum reliability and availability of analyzer systems while working towards achieving plant reliability goals and measuring the effectiveness of maintenance programs.
 Review process flow diagrams, analyzer drawings, sample system drawings, equipment lists, and technical specifications to develop and execute maintenance activities.
 Collaborate with Operations, Engineering, Reliability, and third-party analyzer service providers to support plant performance and reliability.
 Contribute to the continuous improvement of maintenance key performance indicators.
 HSSE 
 100% compliance with company HSE policies and guidelines.
 Champion HSE as a member of the LNG Operations Team.
 Lead HSE Shift Meeting/ safety walks/audits if and when required.
 Timely intervention to mitigate risks and ensure the safety of personnel and plant.
 Demonstrate a personal commitment to influence overall safety behavior in the plant.
 Safeguarding systems check lists are implemented/completed by Shift Operations to agreed frequencies and standards.
 Execute plant wide operations hazards awareness program.

 Minimum of 5+ years of relevant industrial maintenance experience.

 Experience with ABB PGC5000, ABB PGC1000, ABB AO2000 CEMS, and ABB RVP4501 analyzers.
 Experience with analyzer sample conditioning systems and calibration gas systems.
 Knowledge of regulatory requirements in BC
 Proficiency with Yokogawa control systems.
 Commissioning and start-up experience.

 Experience with analyzer calibration, validation, and troubleshooting.
 Previous experience using a Project Resource Manager (PRM) and Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS), such as SAP.

 About the role 
 We are looking for a Principal Engineer to help build GitLab Duo Agent Platform, the agentic orchestration layer that runs AI agents and flows across the entire software lifecycle.
 Principal Engineers at GitLab are recognized experts across multiple technology domains and represent the senior technical leadership within their organization. In this role you will set technical direction for a significant part of the Agent Platform, working across several teams to turn agentic capabilities into something engineering organizations can actually depend on: predictable, observable, governable, and fast enough to sit in the critical path of real development work.
 The Agent Platform is not a single service. It spans agent execution and orchestration, flow definition and event-driven triggering, the AI Catalog through which customers discover and manage agents, model routing and evaluation, and the governance surface that decides which agents may act where and under whose identity. It runs on GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, and Self-Managed installations, including deployments that use self-hosted models to meet compliance requirements. You will work on the parts of that system where the hard architectural questions live, and you will do it hands-on.
 This role reports into the VP of the AI Engineering organization and works closely with Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, Product Management, Infrastructure and Security.
 What you'll do 
 Define the technical direction for a significant area of Duo Agent Platform across several teams, and partner with Engineering Managers and Product to turn it into a roadmap with a six-month horizon.
 Build the orchestration layer that makes agents and flows reliable: session lifecycle, tool invocation, context assembly, concurrency, retries, timeouts, and failure modes that degrade gracefully instead of stalling a developer's workflow.
 Hands on work on driving topics throughout the whole organisation from POC level, architecture to full implementation. 
 Participate in Incident Management on-call rotation, to help meet availability goals for GitLab.com.
 Strong product builder and ownership mentality. Understanding of product strategy, technical strategy, delivering customer value and iteration towards a successful product
 Write clear, opinionated design documents, architecture narratives, and decision records that let other teams make aligned decisions. Ensure the architecture holds across multi-tenant GitLab.com, Dedicated, and Self-Managed deployments, including self-hosted model configurations, and respects data governance boundaries in each.
 Use the platform on our own work, find where it falls short of what we claim, and feed that back through improvements into the product.
 Mentor Staff and Senior Engineers, and raise the bar for experimentation rigor and cross-team collaboration.
 Work across the whole platform on different projects, features and teams. This reaches across:
 Design the extensibility surface so customers can build custom agents and flows, connect their own tools and internal systems, and bring external agents such as Claude Code and Codex into GitLab workflows without weakening the platform's guarantees.
 Drive down the cost and latency of agentic requests, and work with Product on how model selection, routing, and credit consumption behave as usage grows.
 Define the evaluation practice for the platform: offline benchmarks and online experiments that measure task completion, correctness, tool-call accuracy, latency, and cost per task, and that catch regressions before customers do.
 Build the governance and safety surface with Security and Compliance: policy-driven controls over which agents and models may run where, permission and identity semantics that align to existing roles and group structure, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, traceability of every flow session, and audit that stands up to enterprise review.
 Complete Interview Training and participate in hiring for the department as a technical interviewer or panel member.
 Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.
 What you'll bring 
 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years at Staff, Principal level or equivalent senior technical leadership.
 Hands-on production experience building on large language models: agent loops, tool calling, context management, retrieval, prompt and model evaluation. Experience shipping this to real users, not only prototyping it.
 Strong background in distributed systems, including service decomposition, fault tolerance, observability, and operational resilience under multi-tenant load.
 A track record of defining evaluation frameworks and using benchmark and experiment results to make architecture decisions, rather than shipping on intuition.
 Experience designing human-in-the-loop controls, safety guardrails, and responsible AI practices for systems that act on a customer's behalf.
 Ability to drive alignment across Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, and Security on problems that start out ambiguous.
 Experience mentoring senior engineers and shaping technical direction across multiple teams without direct authority.
 Comfort working in one or more of Ruby, Go, Python, or TypeScript, and willingness to work across the stack the platform spans.
 Excellent written and asynchronous communication, and the ability to work effectively in a fully remote, globally distributed organization.
 About the team 
 The AI engineering organisation is building the product and infrastructure that make GitLab an effective environment for running agents across the software development lifecycle. We’re distributed across the world and partner with teams throughout GitLab to help the GitLab Duo Agent Platform become the backbone of GitLab's AI features. You will report directly to the VP of Engineering for AI and especially work together with all the teams, the engineering management and other principal engineers in the AI department. This is an opportunity to lead a consequential group as AI changes how software is built.

 When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades. 
 AI is central to where we're going. Not as a feature but as core infrastructure. We're embedding intelligence directly into the workflows our customers rely on every day, and we're doing it alongside them. Our customers tell us what the mission demands. We build what answers it. 
 This work attracts a specific kind of person — someone who wants to be pushed by great people, build things that outlast a sprint cycle, and go home knowing the work connected back to something real. 
 The Role 
 The Director of Customer Success leads the post-sale customer lifecycle across all customer segments, ensuring customers realize measurable value, adopt solutions effectively, and renew and expand over time. This role is accountable for building and scaling a high-performing Customer Success organization operating under a “One Account, One Owner” model, with clear ownership of customer outcomes across Strategic, Enterprise, State, and Transactional accounts. 
 The Director defines how Customer Success operates—establishing engagement models, operating cadence, and cross-functional alignment—while ensuring consistent execution across the core pillars of Strategic Engagement, Adoption, Expansion, and Retention. The role partners closely with Sales, Project Delivery/Onboarding, Support, Product, and Marketing to deliver a seamless and scalable customer experience. 
 This job posting is being used to fill an existing vacancy. 
 What You Do 
 Customer Success Strategy & Execution 
 Execute Customer Success strategies across all customer segments, ensuring alignment to company growth and retention objectives. 
 Establish standardized customer lifecycle motions, including success planning, business reviews, adoption programs, and renewal readiness. 
 Ensure a proactive, outcome-driven approach to customer engagement focused on value realization and measurable impact. 
 Build scalable processes and playbooks that reduce duplication and ensure consistency across Customer Success teams. 
 Operating Model & Segmentation 
 Lead a multi-tier engagement model across Strategic, State, Enterprise, and Transactional accounts. 
 Operationalize a hub-and-spoke model, where Customer Success Managers own relationships and provide general project knowledge and engage specialists for additional targeted support. 
 Ensure role clarity across Customer Success and adjacent teams, reinforcing boundaries around support, project delivery/onboarding, and sales ownership. 
 Continuously refine segmentation and coverage models to balance engagement with scalable programs. 
 Own end-to-end retention and renewals strategy, by executing a proactive renewal motion (initiating 180–90 days pre-expiry), enforcing disciplined commercial rigor across procurement cycles, and operationalizing cross-functional support to drive on-time renewals, maximize ARR retention and price increases, mitigate churn risk, and ensure consistent value realization for customers. 
 Cross-Functional Leadership 
 Partner with Sales, Project Delivery/Onboarding, Support, Product, and Marketing to deliver a cohesive customer experience. 
 Establish clear handoffs and accountability across onboarding, Customer Success, and renewals. 
 Serve as an escalation point for high-risk or high-impact customer situations to ensure satisfactory customer resolution and support. 
 Provide Voice of Customer insights to influence product roadmap and go-to-market strategy. 
 Data, Reporting & Performance Management 
 Own and drive gross and net revenue retention across the customer portfolio, aligning performance to company financial targets. 
 Define and operationalize success metrics across Customer Success and Renewals, including retention, on-time renewals, customer health, business review quality, and expansion pipeline influence. 
 Design and execute structured renewal motions, incorporating early engagement, procurement tracking, and risk mitigation to ensure predictable, on-time renewals. 
 Leading the Renewals team and partnering with sales teams to drive expansion opportunities and maximize lifetime value. 
 Proactively identify churn risks through health, adoption, and engagement signals; implement targeted save plans to mitigate attrition. 
 Establish and maintain customer health scoring models to guide segmentation, prioritization, and intervention strategies. 
 Drive a consistent operating cadence (e.g., pipeline reviews, business reviews) to assess customer health, renewal forecasts, and team performance; coach proactively and enforce accountability. 
 Ensure CRM hygiene and data integrity (e.g., Salesforce), enabling accurate forecasting, renewal visibility, and revenue reporting. 
 Analyze systemic risks and performance trends, translating insights into process improvements, playbook enhancements, and program investments.

 Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Communications, or a related field. 
 10+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or related SaaS roles. 
 5+ years of experience leading teams and developing people leaders. 
 Proven experience owning retention, renewals, and customer growth metrics at scale. 
 Strong understanding of Customer Success operating models, including segmentation and scaled engagement strategies.

Vous joindre à AbbVie signifie que vous ferez partie d’une équipe de professionnels exceptionnels qui se sont engagés à avoir un impact remarquable sur la vie des patients. Chez AbbVie, nous effectuons des recherches scientifiques révolutionnaires à l’échelle mondiale au quotidien. AbbVie Canada est l’un des meilleurs lieux de travail au Canada.
 Lorsque vous déterminez votre cheminement de carrière, choisissez d’être remarquable.
 AbbVie a pour mission de découvrir et d’offrir des médicaments novateurs pour répondre à des besoins importants en matière de santé aujourd’hui et relever les défis médicaux de demain. AbbVie met tout en œuvre afin d’avoir un impact remarquable sur la vie des gens dans divers secteurs thérapeutiques clés, dont l’immunologie, l’oncologie, les neurosciences, les soins de la vue, la virologie, la santé des femmes et la gastroentérologie, de même que dans le domaine de l’esthétique par le truchement des produits et services d’Allergan Esthétique. 
 Résumé du poste 
 Le poste de Chef, Établissement stratégique des prix consiste à diriger l’établissement des prix pour un ou plusieurs secteurs thérapeutiques (ST) attitrés, en élaborant et en mettant en œuvre la stratégie de prix tout au long du cycle de vie des produits, du lancement et des nouvelles indications jusqu’à l’arrivée des produits génériques. La personne titulaire collabore étroitement avec l’Accès au marché du ST, l’Économie de la santé, les Finances, les Affaires juridiques et l’équipe mondiale afin de protéger l’accès des patients et la valeur commerciale, tout en respectant les exigences du CEPMB et des payeurs. Elle contribue également aux capacités communes d’établissement des prix qui soutiennent tous les ST.
 Responsabilités principales
 Stratégie de prix : Assumer la responsabilité des évaluations de prix pour les actifs attitrés, y compris les options de prix, les scénarios, les analyses de sensibilité et les répercussions sur les prix de liste et nets, et recommander une position de prix.
 Analyses de rentabilité et modélisation des ententes : Diriger l’apport de l’établissement des prix aux analyses de rentabilité de l’accès, y compris la modélisation des prix nets et des ententes, les analyses comparatives et les hypothèses clés; assurer une vigilance à l’égard des prix des produits concurrents et de la réglementation sur les prix afin qu’AbbVie occupe une position concurrentielle, tout en respectant des pratiques d’établissement des prix conformes.
 Négociations avec les payeurs : Élaborer les volets d’établissement des prix de la préparation des négociations avec les payeurs publics et privés, y compris les offres et les contre-offres, l’économie des ententes et les paramètres de négociation; appuyer la direction dans les négociations stratégiques.
 Contrats et conditions commerciales : Examiner les prix et les conditions commerciales dans les lettres d’intention (LI), les ententes d’inscription de produits (EIP), les modifications et les renouvellements.
 Gouvernance et conformité : Gérer les risques liés aux prix, les remontées d’information, les dossiers d’approbation et la mise en œuvre conformément aux exigences du CEPMB et aux politiques internes.
 Gouvernance mondiale des prix : Gérer les processus internes d’approbation des prix et de gouvernance mondiale pour les actifs attitrés; travailler en étroite collaboration avec l’équipe mondiale de l’Établissement des prix pour assurer l’harmonisation avec les directives mondiales d’établissement des prix et le développement des analyses de rentabilité.
 Soutien relatif au CEPMB : Appuyer les obligations de déclaration auprès du CEPMB et toute enquête sur d’éventuels revenus excessifs, en fournissant des données et des analyses sur les prix.
 Suivi des politiques : Suivre les politiques d’établissement des prix fédérales, provinciales et des payeurs ayant une incidence sur l’industrie pharmaceutique, et tenir les parties prenantes internes concernées informées.
 Gestion des produits génériques et du cycle de vie : Mettre à jour les scénarios d’impact sur les prix lors du lancement de produits génériques et collaborer avec les Finances à l’évaluation de l’incidence sur les prévisions.
 Planification du ST : Agir à titre de personne-ressource unique responsable de l’établissement des prix pour le ST; contribuer à la planification du ST, au plan à long terme et au plan annuel.
 Collaboration : Travailler de façon interfonctionnelle avec l’Accès au marché, l’Économie de la santé, les Finances, les Affaires juridiques, l’équipe mondiale et les Opérations, et établir des relations de travail positives avec les fonctions internes et les bureaux mondiaux et régionaux d’AbbVie; respecter les transferts de dossiers, les décisions et les échéances; contribuer aux outils, aux processus et aux pratiques exemplaires d’établissement des prix communs à tous les ST, et appuyer ses collègues durant les périodes de pointe.
Formation et expérience 
 Baccalauréat en commerce, en économie, en finances, en sciences de la vie ou dans un domaine connexe; MBA ou diplôme d’études supérieures, un atout.
 Au moins 3 ans d’expérience dans l’industrie pharmaceutique en établissement des prix, en accès au marché, en finances commerciales ou en stratégie.
 Connaissance fonctionnelle du contexte canadien de l’établissement des prix et du remboursement, y compris le CEPMB, l’Alliance pancanadienne pharmaceutique (APP) et les payeurs publics et privés; compréhension de la dynamique des produits génériques et biosimilaires.
 Compétences avancées en modélisation financière et en analyse, y compris l’analyse de scénarios et de sensibilité.
 Sens des affaires et expérience du soutien aux négociations, avec la capacité de transformer des analyses complexes en recommandations claires pour les hauts dirigeants.
 Aptitudes et outils 
 Capacité de synthétiser et de communiquer des concepts et des résultats complexes, et de préparer des rapports et des présentations pour la haute direction.
 Communications écrites et orales concises et de haute qualité, qui mettent l’accent sur les points clés et créent un lien avec les parties prenantes.
 Capacité démontrée de travailler au sein d’équipes interfonctionnelles et d’une grande organisation; excellentes aptitudes pour les relations interpersonnelles et capacité à gérer les conflits de façon constructive.
 Capacité de travailler de manière autonome; souci du détail, résilience et sens de l’organisation, avec de solides aptitudes pour l’exécution simultanée de plusieurs tâches et la gestion de projets.
 Capacité de s’adapter à l’évolution des besoins et des exigences des clients dans un environnement en changement.
 Outils et systèmes : Expérience en analyse des renseignements commerciaux; expérience de SAP, des outils analytiques d’IQVIA et des bases de données PriceRight; capacité d’élaborer ou d’adapter des modèles dans Excel à partir de données structurées et non structurées; maîtrise de la suite MS Office (Word, Excel et PowerPoint).
 Maîtrise de l’IA : Fait preuve de curiosité et d’adaptabilité dans l’utilisation responsable des outils d’IA afin d’améliorer la productivité, la prise de décision et les façons de travailler.

Aviva is thrilled to announce a new innovative role that offers an unparalleled opportunity to shape the future of engineering services for our customers and claims team.  Aviva recognizes the importance of being flexible and the benefits of being together, this role will be hybrid – the best of both worlds.

This includes conducting detailed field examinations, performing technical analyses of electrical systems and components, and thoroughly documenting all physical and electrical evidence. Your work culminates in comprehensive, timely reports to the Claims Professional outlining your expert opinions, analyses, assessments and recommendations specific to electrical fire losses. In addition, you will support the development of training for our Claims Professionals on electrical fire risks and investigation techniques, while also offering insight to our Underwriters and Aviva Risk Management Solutions (ARMS) to help strengthen risk evaluation and prevention strategies in this specialized area.

 Conduct field investigations of structure fires and explosions, including vehicle fires or equipment failures, documenting your work and collecting all necessary evidence including witness interviews, fire service interviews, media reports, security videos, product recalls etc.

 Contribute to engineering expertise including multi-disciplinary initiatives or emerging risk areas, as required.
 Collaborate with other groups on multidisciplinary projects to provide solutions on complex losses and failures.

 The Role 
 BeyondTrust is a global leader in privileged access management. Our products provide remote access and privileged control capabilities that are deployed across thousands of enterprise environments worldwide. That makes us a high-value target. Nation-state actors, ransomware operators, and sophisticated threat groups actively target companies like ours—not just to compromise our corporate environment, but to reach the customers who trust our software to protect their most sensitive systems. A compromise of BeyondTrust is a compromise of the privileged access layer inside our customers’ networks. We take that responsibility seriously.
 As a Cyber Defense Engineer on our Cyber Defense Operations team, you will serve as a front-line defender responsible for protecting both BeyondTrust’s enterprise infrastructure and the integrity of the products our customers depend on. You will monitor, investigate, and respond to security events in an environment where the stakes are real and the adversaries are capable. You will work alongside experienced threat hunters, incident responders, and detection engineers in a collaborative team that values sharp analytical thinking over checkbox compliance.
 This team is building toward an AI-augmented operating model. You will be expected to use AI-driven tools in your daily work and to contribute to how we integrate these capabilities into our detection, triage, and response workflows. We are not looking for people who are waiting to be told what to do—we are looking for people who want to build something.
 What You’ll Do 
 Alert Triage & Monitoring 
 Monitor and triage security alerts across SIEM, EDR, and CSPM platforms covering both corporate and product environments.
 Investigate alerts to determine scope, severity, and whether escalation is warranted.
 Leverage AI-assisted triage and enrichment tools to accelerate analysis and reduce mean time to detect.
 Classify, document, and track alerts through the full lifecycle using ticketing and case management systems.
 Incident Response & Investigation 
 Participate in or lead incident response engagements from detection through remediation, including evidence collection, forensic analysis, root cause determination, and stakeholder communication.
 Conduct investigations across SIEM, EDR, CSPM, and cloud-native log sources including identity provider logs, cloud audit trails, and network flow data—spanning both corporate and product infrastructure.
 Execute established IR runbooks across identity, endpoint, cloud, and email investigation workflows.
 Manage or assist with evidence handling, forensic artifact collection, and chain-of-custody procedures.
 Produce clear, decision-ready incident summaries and post-incident reports for both technical and leadership audiences.
 Detection Engineering & Threat Intelligence 
 Contribute to the design, implementation, and tuning of detection rules across SIEM and EDR platforms, with a focus on reducing false positives and closing coverage gaps.
 Translate threat intelligence (CVE advisories, CISA alerts, vendor bulletins, open-source feeds) into actionable detection content, with particular attention to threats targeting privileged access tooling and supply chain attack vectors.
 Help maintain and evolve detection coverage mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.
 Partner with threat hunting peers to validate detection logic through hypothesis-driven hunts.
 AI Integration & Automation 
 Use AI-driven tools for alert triage, enrichment, and investigation as a standard part of daily operations.
 Contribute to the evaluation, integration, and optimization of AI and automation capabilities across the team’s workflows.
 Assist in designing prompts, agent workflows, or LLM-based pipelines that augment analyst capabilities and reduce manual effort.
 Partner with engineering teams to improve log ingestion, data quality, and tool integrations.
 Operational Excellence 
 Maintain daily operational notes and shift handoff documentation.
 Contribute to and refine IR runbooks, playbooks, and standard operating procedures.
 Participate in on-call rotation for after-hours incident escalation.
 Track and report on operational metrics (MTTD, MTTR, MTTC, false positive rate) and identify improvement opportunities.
 Participate in tabletop exercises, purple team activities, and post-incident reviews. 
 What You’ll Bring 
 4+ years of experience in a SOC, security operations, or incident response role.
 Understanding of common attack frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK), network protocols, and endpoint behavior.
 Experience with at least one SIEM platform and familiarity with writing search or detection queries.
 Familiarity with EDR platforms and cloud environments (IaaS preferred).
 Comfort using AI systems (e.g., LLM-based assistants, copilots, or AI-driven analysis tools) as part of security workflows.
 Strong written communication skills; able to document findings clearly and concisely for both technical and non-technical audiences.
 Nice To Have 
 Experience leading or co-leading complex incident response engagements from triage through remediation.
 Experience with identity and access management platforms and cloud security posture management tools.
 Scripting and automation skills (Python, PowerShell, or equivalent) applied to security workflows.
 Familiarity with SOAR platforms or orchestration tools for automated response and enrichment.
 Experience designing or implementing AI agent architectures, LLM-based automation pipelines, or prompt engineering for security use cases.
 Experience building or contributing to threat intelligence programs or detection-as-code pipelines.
 Understanding of the privileged access management landscape and the threat actors that target it.
 Track record of evaluating and adopting emerging technologies in a production security environment.
 Better Together

 We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.
 About Us

 BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.

 What We Need 
 Define scalable rack-scale communication architecture for AI accelerators, GPUs, CPUs, switches, network adapters, memory, and I/O, including topology, lane counts, link budgets, redundancy, and 224G, 448G, and future-rate interfaces.

 How to define the complete communication fabric for next-generation rack-scale AI systems as bandwidth scales from 224G to 448G and beyond.
 How to make system-level choices between electrical reach, flyover cables, near-package optics, and co-packaged optics while balancing power, latency, cost, volume, and reliability.
 How package, PCB, connector, cable, optical-engine, and fiber decisions combine to determine end-to-end channel performance and manufacturability.
 How to shape the interconnect technology roadmap through collaboration with ASIC, package, PCB, optical, mechanical, and system teams, as well as semiconductor and component suppliers.
 How to evaluate and bring emerging technologies, including silicon photonics, 800G/1.6T+ optics, advanced packaging, and next-generation SerDes, toward production AI infrastructure.

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 
 Airbnb a pris le jour en 2007 lorsque deux Hôtes ont accueilli trois invités dans leur maison de San Francisco, et compte depuis lors plus de 4 millions d'Hôtes qui ont accueilli plus d'un milliard d'invités dans presque tous les pays du monde. Chaque jour, les Hôtes proposent des séjours et des expériences uniques qui permettent aux invités de se connecter de manière plus authentique aux communautés.
 La communauté que vous rejoindrez: 
 Nous recherchons un(e) candidat(e) engagé(e) et enthousiaste pour offrir un service client exceptionnel à la communauté Airbnb en tant que Spécialiste du service client, Support Premium. Le/la candidat(e) idéal(e) est accueillant(e), analytique et déterminé(e) à offrir un service de la plus haute qualité, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit, en Anglais et en Francais. 
 La différence que vous ferez: 
 L'associé(e) du support premium fonctionne en première ligne et interagit directement avec les clients et les parties prenantes internes. En tant qu'associé(e) du support premium, vous serez responsable de fournir un support de bout en bout aux membres clés de notre communauté, y compris, mais sans s'y limiter, le segment Luxe. Vous prendrez en charge les cas, garantissant une résolution complète tout en favorisant des relations solides avec nos utilisateurs tout au long du processus. Les associés du support premium ont besoin de solides compétences en communication, de capacités de résolution de problèmes et d'une expertise en matière de service client. Ils doivent également être adaptables et réactifs dans notre environnement en évolution rapide, parfois sous pression, tout en restant flexibles, proactifs, ingénieux, efficaces et démontrant un haut niveau de professionnalisme et de confidentialité.
 Une journée typique: 
 Gestion de cas complexes : Fournir le plus haut niveau de service à notre communauté dans chaque cas 
 Interagir avec les clients Airbnb et les membres de la communauté via tous les canaux actuels et futurs, à la fois à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur des outils Airbnb, y compris le chat en direct, les plateformes sociales, la messagerie et directement par téléphone.
 S'approprier de bout en bout tous les cas assignés : garantir qu'une résolution finale complète (ou un règlement, une décision finale, etc.) est atteinte sur la base des flux de travail et des directives de gestion, en favorisant la relation avec nos utilisateurs tout au long du processus et en les transmettant avec précision aux autres équipes le cas échéant.
 Démontrer une mentalité de propriétaire et un bon jugement ainsi que la capacité de remettre en question et de s'écarter du flux de travail lorsque cela est nécessaire uniquement avec l'approbation de la direction.
 Être très réceptif aux retours de la Direction et de la Qualité, et adopter rapidement des comportements pour améliorer la qualité de votre travail.
 Comprendre plusieurs perspectives sur un sujet ou une situation et est capable d'évaluer et de présenter plusieurs options pour résoudre un problème.
 Peut être amené à s'engager davantage avec les parties prenantes de haut niveau et à collaborer de manière interfonctionnelle, avec l'aide de la direction.
 Combiner efficacité et qualité sur mesure : Fournir un support client personnalisé et exceptionnel aux voyageurs et aux hôtes, en veillant à ce que leurs besoins et préférences uniques soient satisfaits avec le plus haut niveau de soin et d'attention. 
 Afficher une capacité à traiter un plus grand volume de cas sans impact négatif sur la qualité de l'interaction et la résolution.
 Anticiper et identifier de manière proactive les opportunités d'améliorer l'expérience utilisateur et, avec le soutien de la direction, proposer des solutions et des recommandations sur mesure qui vont au-delà de leurs attentes, et garantir une expérience fluide et mémorable tout au long de leurs interactions avec Airbnb.
 Résoudre les problèmes des utilisateurs rapidement et avec un niveau élevé de satisfaction mutuelle, en tenant compte du contexte et des circonstances spécifiques.
 Personnaliser les communications avec les utilisateurs, en démontrant les normes d'hospitalité les plus élevées.
 Participer à l'amélioration de votre équipe : exploitez vos connaissances opérationnelles fonctionnelles pour soutenir de manière proactive la réussite de l'équipe 
 Fournir des informations sur l'expérience de la communauté et les opportunités d'amélioration continue à votre direction.
 Aider à documenter les méthodes de travail, les meilleures pratiques et les normes pour votre (vos) service (s), à la demande de la direction.
 Fournir des services techniques/fonctionnels/SME aux membres les moins expérimentés de l'équipe.
 Partager des idées pour améliorer les processus et les méthodes de travail.
 Engagement des parties prenantes : Vous avez gagné la confiance des parties prenantes internes et externes grâce à une gestion efficace des relations et à l'obtention de résultats. 
 Faire preuve d’ouverture et d’accessibilité lors de la résolution des problèmes.
 Comprendre les principaux moteurs de votre fonction et leurs relations les uns avec les autres, ainsi que l'impact commercial de ces mesures.
 Être de garde pour gérer les situations d'urgence le soir et le week-end.
 Votre expertise: 
 Votre parcours et votre expérience 
 Au moins 3 ans d'expérience pertinente dans des équipes de service client multiculturelles, de préférence dans le secteur hôtelier (une expérience avec une clientèle de haut niveau et influente est préférable) et dans un rôle de prise d'appels et de gestion des contacts clients/clients.
 Une expérience en hôtellerie est un plus, notamment en travaillant pour des plateformes technologiques. Une expérience préalable de l'utilisation du téléphone, de la messagerie ou du chat en direct pour interagir avec les utilisateurs/clients est préférable. 
 Expérience en collaboration avec des parties prenantes de niveau exécutif pour résoudre les conflits de manière détaillée, efficace et rapide, et capacité démontrée à expliquer des idées complexes de manière simple et claire.
 Capacité à travailler les week-ends et les jours fériés requis, ainsi que les quarts de soir. Veuillez noter que ce rôle nécessite de travailler du dimanche au jeudi OU du mardi au samedi pendant 9 heures par jour (y compris une pause d'une heure) entre 6 h et 21 h (dans votre fuseau horaire local à travers le Canada). Votre horaire peut changer pour répondre aux besoins de l'entreprise et, dans la mesure du possible, nous prendrons en considération vos disponibilités. 
 Vos compétences et expertises 
 Très bonnes compétences en communication verbale et écrite pour fournir un service client exceptionnel aux voyageurs/hôtes et interagir avec les parties prenantes
 Compétences d'écoute active pour comprendre les besoins des clients et fournir des recommandations et une assistance personnalisées
 Empathie et patience dans les relations avec les clients, en particulier dans les situations de haute pression
 Capacité à organiser un volume de travail élevé, à effectuer plusieurs tâches et à établir des priorités, et à travailler selon des horaires prescrits, y compris les pauses, les déjeuners et le temps de formation.
 Passion pour offrir un service client exceptionnel et placer la barre haute
 Capacité à prospérer dans un environnement ambigu, rapide et complexe, en agissant de manière proactive pour réagir rapidement et de manière décisive.
 Bonnes compétences informatiques, notamment Apple/Mac OS, Google Suite, connaissance des systèmes CRM et capacité d'apprendre rapidement de nouveaux outils.
 Maîtrise de l'anglais et francais obligatoire.
 Votre emplacement : 
 En raison de la nature de ce poste, le candidat retenu devra être basé au Canada pour pouvoir effectuer son travail. Actuellement, les employés peuvent être situés dans : la Colombie-Britannique, l'Ontario, le Québec, l'Alberta ou le Saskatchewan. Cette liste est continuellement mise à jour, veuillez vérifier avec nous si les provinces dans lesquelles vous vivez figurent sur la liste. Si votre poste est employé par une autre entité Airbnb, votre recruteur vous informera des provinces dans lesquelles vous êtes éligible pour travailler.
 Notre engagement envers l’inclusion et l’appartenance : 
 Airbnb s'engage à travailler avec le vivier de talents le plus large possible. Nous pensons que la diversité des idées favorise l’innovation et l’engagement, et nous permet d’attirer des personnes créatives et de développer les meilleurs produits, services et solutions. Toutes les personnes qualifiées sont encouragées à postuler.
 Nous nous efforçons également de proposer un processus de candidature et d'entretien inclusif pour les personnes handicapées. Si vous êtes un candidat handicapé et avez besoin d'aménagements raisonnables pour soumettre une candidature, veuillez nous contacter à l'adresse : raisonnableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Veuillez inclure votre nom complet, le poste pour lequel vous postulez et les aménagements nécessaires pour vous aider dans le processus de recrutement. 
 Nous vous demandons de nous contacter uniquement si vous êtes un candidat dont le handicap vous empêche de remplir notre candidature en ligne.
 Nous utilisons des outils automatisés pour aider notre équipe de recrutement à examiner efficacement un grand nombre de candidatures. Toutes les décisions finales d’embauche sont prises par une personne humaine. 
 Ce poste correspond à un poste vacant au sein de l'organisation. 
 How We'll Take Care of You: 
 Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits. 
 Canada Annual Pay Range
 $58,000 — $64,000 CAD 
 Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role. 
 A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ airbnb.com or @ ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

 About the Storage Execution team
 The Storage Execution team sits at the heart of MongoDB’s Online Transaction Processing (OLTP) team. We own the core transactional read/write path on each node, across both today’s storage engine and a next‑generation cloud-native storage architecture. Our work determines how correct and performant MongoDB is for customers running mission-critical production workloads.
 The team’s responsibilities include:
 Defining and maintaining the internal collection and index APIs used by Replication, Query and Catalog modules, and commands for local reads and writes, plus the transaction and durability primitives that govern visibility, conflict resolution and crash recovery
 Integrating the next generation of MongoDB’s storage architecture into the server in a way that is predictable for other teams, scales with cloud elasticity, and preserves the performance and safety of the classic configuration
 Improving transaction processing speed and semantics of both single shard and cross-shard transactions
 Owning index builds and schema‑level storage operations (build/rebuild, cleanup, resumability) and ensuring they behave well for large, highly available clusters running write-heavy workloads
 Building validation, diagnostics, and storage‑focused test infrastructure to catch durability issues early and keep the system trustworthy at scale
 Partnering with neighboring teams on flow control, prioritization and load-shedding to stay within resource limits, protecting durability and availability at the cluster level without starving critical operations

Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked. 
 That is the whole job.
 Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.
 So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.
 At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.
 You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.
 Here is what "end to end" actually means.
 You are the account manager. We do not have any.  You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.
 You own the whole funnel, not the campaign.  Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.
 You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it.  We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.
 You can live anywhere.  We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.
 If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.
 If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.
 What the job looks like 
 Own a set of DTC accounts  as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
 Own the client relationship.  There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
 Audit before you touch anything.  Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
 Run brand and non brand as different businesses.  Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
 Know what PMax is actually doing.  The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
 Keep Google's automation on a leash.  Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
 Own the feed.  Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
 Own the tracking.  GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
 Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it.  Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
 Build the things the account needs.  Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.
 You are a fit if 
 You have done this with real money.  Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
 You are fluent in the whole stack , not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
 You are AI native, and you build.  This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
 You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level.  You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
 You are skeptical of your own numbers.  You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
 You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls.  Where you live is up to you.
 Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.
 You are not a fit if 
 "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
 You want to be told what to do this week.
 You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
 You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.
 Why this role is exciting 
 This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.
 You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.
 You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.
 You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

The category scope includes facility management services, third-party labor, operational supplies and consumables, Material Handling Equipment (MHE), racking, automation and other facility-related requirements .
 The position will apply Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), should-cost modelling, external benchmarks and market intelligence to identify opportunities, strengthen commercial decisions and drive sustainable cost leadership across the categories in scope.
 Working closely with Operations, Finance, Accounts Payable, Legal, Technology, Vendor Master Data Management and other stakeholders, the role will help streamline the end-to-end procurement process, ensuring negotiated agreements, pricing, suppliers and purchasing channels are effectively deployed and translated into operational results.

 Key Responsabilities 
 Sourcing Strategy & Execution 
 ·       Manage Source-to-Contract activities for Facilities and related categories across Canada, including Contract Logistics, Ground Freight, Depots and other L&S operations.
 ·       Execute sourcing initiatives covering facility management services, operational supplies and consumables, MHE, racking, automation and related facility requirements .
 ·       Conduct spend, demand and supplier analysis to identify sourcing, consolidation and standardization opportunities.
 ·       Develop category-specific go-to-market and sourcing strategies based on business requirements, supplier capabilities, market dynamics and commercial opportunities.
 ·       Lead RFQ/RFP processes, including supplier engagement, bid analysis, commercial evaluation, negotiations, recommendations and award implementation.
 ·       Develop and apply TCO and should-cost models to improve commercial decision-making and optimize lifecycle economics beyond initial purchase price.
 ·       Develop and maintain external benchmarks for key cost drivers, rates, equipment and services to support negotiations and drive cost leadership.
 ·       Monitor relevant market trends, supplier developments, capacity, inflationary factors and technology developments and translate insights into sourcing actions.
 ·       Support contract development and negotiation in collaboration with Legal and relevant stakeholders.
 ·       Deliver measurable cost savings, cost avoidance and other value improvements while balancing service, quality, operational requirements and risk.
 Rate Management & Commercial Implementation 
 ·       Own the implementation and ongoing maintenance of negotiated supplier rates, pricing conditions and commercial agreements within applicable procurement systems.
 ·       Ensure sourcing awards are effectively translated into contracts, purchase orders, catalogues, rate structures and approved buying channels.
 ·       Monitor commercial conditions and identify missing, incorrect or outdated rates, coordinating corrective actions with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
 ·       Resolve Procurement-owned pricing and commercial discrepancies, including price mismatches affecting the three-way-match and payment process.
 ·       Establish effective mechanisms to maintain visibility of pricing, rate validity, contract coverage and commercial performance.
 Vendor Onboarding, Compliance & Enablement 
 ·       Coordinate supplier onboarding and implementation across Procurement, Operations, Finance, Accounts Payable, Vendor Master Data Management and other process owners.
 ·       Ensure awarded suppliers are properly enabled through appropriate purchasing channels, including catalogues, punchouts, framework purchasing and PO-based processes .
 ·       Manage sourcing and procurement documentation to ensure appropriate governance, audit readiness and traceability.
 ·       Drive contract compliance and adoption of negotiated suppliers, rates, terms and purchasing channels .

 Demand-to-Delivery & Procure-to-Pay Enablement

 ·       Identify root causes of recurring purchasing, pricing and payment issues and coordinate corrective actions across relevant stakeholders.
 ·       Support improved Payment on Time (POT) by addressing procurement-related causes of invoice and payment delays.
 Digitalization, AI & Continuous Improvement 
 ·       Champion the adoption of digital procurement solutions, automation and AI-enabled capabilities across Source-to-Contract and Procure-to-Pay activities.
 ·       Identify and implement opportunities to automate repetitive activities including sourcing intake, quotation comparison, rate maintenance, catalogue management, transaction monitoring and exception management.
